description: A clear plastic food container sits on the table with three small rubber duck toys in front of it and a matching lid with gray latches to the right. The left hand steadies the open container while the right hand picks up the pink duck and drops it inside, then moves the other ducks into the container; next the right hand lifts the lid, lowers it onto the container, and both hands press and align it to close, making the container a two-hand object.
